name: LiveAgentBench
description: LiveAgentBench is a comprehensive benchmark with 104 real-world scenarios reflecting user requirements, constructed from publicly sourced questions on social media and products. It evaluates agentic systems on practical tasks with 374 tasks total, including validation and testing sets.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for agentic systems that has not yet seen broad community adoption, but is positioned as a practical real-world evaluation suite.
notes: Uses Social Perception-Driven Data Generation (SPDG) to ensure real-world relevance and verifiability; supports continuous updates.
